svg.title: KEPLER S-17 — five-view spacecraft engineering blueprint
svg.desc: A single self-contained vector drawing of a fictional 30 metre cislunar logistics spacecraft. Coordinated top, port side, front and rear orthographic views are at 1:100 on a 1000 by 707 millimetre sheet. An enlarged 1:80 longitudinal cutaway shares the same hull stations. The deployed solar array span is 24 metres, pressure hull diameter is 4.8 metres, docking aperture diameter is 1.3 metres, and four engines use 1.56 metre nozzle exits. Numbered leaders identify propulsion, LOX and liquid methane tanks, crew cabin, cockpit, paired airlocks, docking interface, solar arrays, reaction control pods, radiators, antennas, landing gear, cargo pallets, avionics, life support, primary structure and electrical power systems. Dimensions, datum stations, section A-A, structural hatching, engine centre spacing, scale bars, line conventions, equipment index and drawing control block are included. Concept design only; dimensions are nominal and do not constitute a validated flight design.

g.title: Drawing Control Block
g.text: 01 All dimensions nominal; metres unless indicated. Do not scale from a resized display.
02 Exterior views: 1:100. Section A–A: 1:80. Scales apply at 1000 × 707 mm sheet size.
03 Deployed reference arrangement; equipment behind the section plane is projected.
04 Conceptual spacecraft architecture. No fabrication tolerances or performance certification.
